The '''Dilonexa system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dilonexa XXIII]].

==Description==
The Dilonexa system was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] along the [[Falko Run]], between the [[Ringneldia system/Legends|Ringneldia]] and [[Ua system]]s.<ref name="TEA" /> It was comprised of forty [[Planet/Legends|planets]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Giant star|giant]] [[Color/Legends|blue-white]] [[Unidentified star (Dilonexa system)|star]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|189|Dilonexa XXIII}}</ref> The only habitable planet was [[Dilonexa XXIII]], with the inner twenty-two too hot to sustain life and the outer seventeen too cold.<ref name="FO" />

==History==
The part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing the Dilonexa system was once controlled by the [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] [[Species/Legends|species's]] [[Unidentified Sharu civilization|civilization]], which was active from around [[30,000 BBY]] until [[25,200 BBY]]. The area was later explored by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime between [[3956 BBY]] and [[3000 BBY]]. In [[3350 BBY]], the system's [[Sector/Legends|sector]] organized an independent government called the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]; however, the cluster of worlds was under the control of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]]. By [[1004 BBY]], the area had fallen under the influence of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], although the faction was dissolved at the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

After the Republic was reformed as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Centrality planets swore allegiance to the new regime, though the Hutts were largely in power during its reign.<ref name="TEA" /> Once the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] took control of the galaxy<ref name="ACGttC" /> in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]],<ref>According to ''The Essential Atlas'', the New Republic [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|took control]] of the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the Empire forty-two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Great ReSynchronization]] dating system was established. Because it placed the [[0 BBY/Legends|year zero]] of the New Republic's dating system at thirty-five years, 6 ABY was found using simple math.</ref> the Centrality sector was again independent of galactic governments.<ref name="ACGttC" /> By [[137 ABY]], the Dilonexa system was within the territory of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Dilonexa system first appeared in ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'', a [[1983]] book written by [[L. Neil Smith]].<ref name="FO" /> It was later mentioned in [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]], released in [[2001]], which contained an eight-page article by [[Michael Kogge]] titled "[[A Campaign Guide to the Centrality]]."<ref name="ACGttC" /> The system's position within the Centrality was depicted in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
